questions.question: Describe your experience preparing, filing, and reconciling sales and use tax returns, including the work you performed for Kansas, Missouri, and Oklahoma.
This role involves preparing and reviewing individual and business income tax returns. What exposure have you had to income tax return preparation or tax work beyond sales and use tax?
Walk me through your month-end close responsibilities at Southern Company, including journal entries, accruals, balance-sheet reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
Give an example of a new accounting or tax procedure you developed or implemented, such as your strategy for collecting and reporting monthly taxes. What was the outcome?
How have you ensured accuracy and policy compliance when auditing purchasing-card activity, coding invoices, or processing accounts payable?
Describe your experience working with fixed assets and capital projects, including asset setup, depreciation, CIP documentation, and budget monitoring.
Tell me about a time you trained colleagues on a financial process or policy. How did you make sure they understood and consistently followed the process?
This position requires leading tax and accounting projects and coordinating with staff and clients. Describe a project you managed across multiple stakeholders and how you kept it on schedule.
What accounting systems have you used, including SAP, AS400, JDE, and CAMS? Which processes did you perform in those systems?
Describe a time you identified a reconciliation issue, coding error, or tax compliance concern. How did you investigate it, correct it, and prevent recurrence?
